channel.title: SnapDeck AI Blog
channel.description: Study tips, memory science and exam prep for students — from the team behind SnapDeck AI.

item.title: How to memorise a lot of information quickly — without the fluff
item.description: The difference between reading something and actually knowing it. Three techniques you can start with a single deck of cards tonight.

item.title: Active recall explained — why it feels worse and how to start
item.description: Active recall is the single most reliable way to remember what you study. It also feels frustratingly difficult — here's why and how to actually do it.

item.title: The night-before-the-exam survival guide
item.description: One evening, more material than time. An honest hour-by-hour triage plan — what to study, what to skip, and what to do in the morning.

item.title: How to take notes you'll actually study from
item.description: Most notes are written to be taken, not used. Four small changes that make your notes worth opening again when the exam is close.

item.title: Why cramming feels great and works terribly
item.description: The confidence you feel at 2 a.m. is real — it's just measuring the wrong thing. Spaced repetition and retrieval practice, explained.
